QuestInfo.name: The Truth Revealed
QuestInfo.0: #bJM's#k conspiracy theory was nothing but a mistake #p9020000# made. You should tell him the truth.
QuestInfo.1: JM is not happy that his conspiracy theory was completely nuts! He wants you to go down there and eliminate #o6220000# just to teach the oversized Croco a lesson!

1.0: You got rid of the #o6220000#? Thanks. You really worked hard on this one, when you had better things to do. Here, let me increase your Fame. It's the least I can do.

yes.0: I learned lots from this incident. First, don't assume everything's a conspiracy. Second, find a good lackey to do all the legwork. And third, #rnever trust #p9020000#. Ever.#k Thanks again.
